description: Feasibility constants, the same values the generator enforces. An assembler pre-computes a legal floor count N for a parcel as: N * minFloorHeight <= parcel maxHeight. With apertures, let reqH(b) = the tallest walkable aperture height at base b; every reqH must be <= maxFloorHeight (else E_APERTURE_UNREACHABLE), because the floor pinned at b must contain the aperture's full vertical extent. Sort the distinct walkable bases 0 < b1 < ... < bk; each gap g from base b (starting at 0) to the next must hold at least max(reqH(b), minFloorHeight) and admits between ceil(g / maxFloorHeight) and (reqH(b) > minFloorHeight ? 1 + floor((g - reqH(b)) / minFloorHeight) : floor(g / minFloorHeight)) floors; the tail above bk needs room >= max(reqH(bk), minFloorHeight) below maxHeight and admits up to 1 + floor((room - max(reqH(bk), minFloorHeight)) / minFloorHeight) floors; N must fall inside the summed range (E_APERTURE_UNREACHABLE names it exactly). Units meters.
